title: Teachers
description: Add or remove current teachers. Current teachers can see the profiles of current (under-age) students, so every change is logged.

add.title: Add a current teacher
add.hint: Search for a member by name, then press “Make current”.
add.none: No one found. Only approved members are listed.

current.title: Current teachers
current.hint: When someone leaves, press “Move to former”. This year is recorded as their leave year; their record stays.
